decisions.reason: As a publicly announced new feature framed as a breakthrough and fitting the firm's secure identity ecosystem, it is likely to be retained despite only moderate visible commitment.
An identity-linked payment wallet sits close to the firm's stated super-app and secure ecosystem strategy, so management has strong reason to continue backing it.

The NFC-tag authenticator is more niche and less central to the platform story than the other launches, but the firm is still likely to persist for now because it belongs to its core authentication domain.
A dedicated product page and its close connection to payments and wallets indicate visible commitment and meaningful investment, which makes withdrawal unlikely.
This product is essentially the firm's strategic direction made concrete in the market, so escalation of commitment strongly favors keeping it.
The application shielding library builds directly on the firm's long-standing security capabilities and was given standalone visibility, making continued support the more likely choice.
